source.author: verg
source.text: Hic demum, hippomanes vero quod nomine dicunt pastores, lentum destillat ab inguine virus, hippomanes, quod saepe malae legere novercae miscueruntque herbas et non innoxia verba.
source.text_original: Hic demum, hippomanes vero quod nomine dicunt / pastores, lentum destillat ab inguine virus, / hippomanes, quod saepe malae legere novercae / miscueruntque herbas et non innoxia verba.
source.text_english: Here at last, what the shepherds truly call hippomanes, a sticky poison drips from the groin, hippomanes, which wicked stepmothers have often gathered and mixed with herbs and harmful spells.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Hippomanes, vero quod nomine dicunt Pastores, lentum distillat ab inguine virus.
reuse.text_original: Hippomanes, vero quod nomine dicunt Pastores, lentum distillat ab inguine virus.
reuse.text_english: Hippo manes, however, what the shepherds call by that name, drips a sticky poison from the groin.
